candidate_model.name: AllFive
candidate_model.training: Existing Session 20 fitted artifact: latest 50000 train targets, 400 trees, depth 6, learning rate 0.05, seed 42, two CPU threads; no refit in Session 25
candidate_model.selection_scope: serving demonstration baseline; not a proven final research winner against a rich current-only control

preprocessing: raw float64 numerical values; infinity -> NaN; native CatBoost missing handling; no clipping, scaling or log transform

metrics.ranking: model score descending, TransactionID ascending for ties
metrics.zero_positive_blocks: AP/recall unavailable; report row and fraud counts explicitly

cost_diagnostic.policy: alert none; comparison baseline only, not a deployed fraud decision policy
cost_diagnostic.formula: sum(amount of missed fraud) + 200 * false positives

chronological_protocol.targets: reserved chronological test interval, only in a separately authorized finalization workflow
chronological_protocol.reference_boundaries: use the existing original chronological splits; do not inspect test to choose windows
chronological_protocol.allowed_history: all earlier unlabeled raw train/validation observations and, under the frozen online-style protocol, earlier test events
chronological_protocol.equal_time_rule: read every event in a timestamp group before committing any event from that group
chronological_protocol.tie_breaking: TransactionID may break ranking/display ties; never creates earlier history among equal-time peers
chronological_protocol.label_use: never build features from target labels; join final labels only after predictions and policy choices are fixed
chronological_protocol.duplicates_and_late_events: reject duplicate IDs; a live late-event/watermark and retry-state policy is not implemented

remaining_before_final_test: Explicitly approve final model selection and evaluation plan using development evidence only
Implement and independently verify the reserved-interval feature construction and label-isolated scoring path without first tuning on its outcomes
Freeze the final candidate release and operational policy or explicit no-policy scope before any test scoring
Run one planned evaluation, report failures and limits, and do not iterate on test outcomes
limitations: The API accepts precomputed features and is not a trusted live feature store
Validation has repeatedly informed development choices
Early full-dataset EDA exposed aggregate test-label statistics; do not claim the project has a pristine untouched test history
Session 20 compared graph features with amount only, not a competitive rich current-only control
Retrospective components do not establish real identities, intent or inference-time coordination
Original training code revision was not recorded; Session 21 provenance was registered afterward
